2026-12-24.headline: Fly to Hanoi · night stopover
2026-12-24.plan:
Flight: Singapore ~4 pm → Hanoi ~7 pm
Overnight in Hanoi. Stay near the airport, or in the Old Quarter (about 45 min away) for a late pho or bun cha dinner.
Morning flight tomorrow, so stay close to the airport.
2026-12-24.food:
Phở Gia Truyền (49 Bát Đàn) — the classic beef pho; check hours if you land late
Bún Chả Hương Liên — grilled pork with noodles, the "Obama combo"
Tạ Hiện (Beer Street) — street stalls and cheap beer open late

2026-12-25.headline: Hanoi → Beijing · Qianmen and Peking duck
2026-12-25.plan:
Flight: Hanoi ~10 am → Beijing ~2:30 pm
Immigration, then the Airport Express or a taxi into the city. Check in.
Evening: walk Qianmen Street and Dashilan hutong, then Peking duck for Christmas dinner.
2026-12-25.food:
Quanjude Qianmen — the original Peking duck house, around since 1864
Xianyukou Food Street — old Beijing snacks: zhajiangmian, tanghulu, fried pastries
Duyichu — shaomai dumplings on Qianmen Street

2026-12-26.headline: Great Wall day trip
2026-12-26.plan:
Leave early for Mutianyu Great Wall: cable car up, toboggan down if it's open in winter.
Afternoon: drive on to Gubei Water Town and see Simatai Great Wall lit up at night.
Dress for well below freezing. You'll be back late.
2026-12-26.food:
The Schoolhouse at Mutianyu — lunch near the Wall in an old village school
Mutianyu village restaurants — rainbow trout and home-style dishes
Gubei Water Town — dinner on the old street before the night views

2026-12-27.headline: Forbidden City, then train to Chongli
2026-12-27.plan:
Morning: Forbidden City (book ahead with your passport; it opens around 8:30). Then a quick climb up Jingshan Park for the view.
Afternoon: high-speed train from Beijing North or Qinghe to Taizicheng (about 1 hr), then the resort shuttle.
Check in, pick up rentals, early night.
2026-12-27.food:
Siji Minfu (Forbidden City branch) — Peking duck by the palace moat; expect a queue
Qingfeng Baozi — quick steamed buns before the train
Hotpot in Chongli for dinner — the easy warm-up after a travel day

2026-12-28.headline: Ski day 1 · Thaiwoo
2026-12-28.plan:
Thaiwoo: good mix of beginner, intermediate and advanced runs.
Book a morning lesson if anyone is new, then ski freely after lunch.
Evening: hotpot and a soak.
2026-12-28.food:
Youmian wowo (莜面窝窝) — Zhangjiakou's oat-noodle rolls, the local dish to try
Lamb hotpot in Thaiwoo village — warms you up after skiing
Slope-side lodges — quick lunch without leaving the mountain (pricey)

2026-12-29.headline: Ski day 2 · Genting or Wanlong
2026-12-29.plan:
Try another resort. Genting Secret Garden hosted the Olympic freestyle and snowboard events. Wanlong has more steep and black runs.
Beginners can stay on Thaiwoo's easy slopes.
2026-12-29.food:
Genting slope-side restaurants — lunch without taking your boots off
Taizicheng Ice & Snow Town — restaurants and food stalls by the station in the evening
Lamb skewers (yangrou chuan) — Hebei does them well; look for a smoky grill

2026-12-30.headline: Last ski morning, train back
2026-12-30.plan:
Ski the morning, return rentals and check out.
Afternoon or evening: train back to Beijing. Some trains don't return to Beijing North, so check the station on your ticket.
Evening, if you have energy: skate or ride ice bikes on the Beihai Park rink.
2026-12-30.food:
Fangshan Restaurant — imperial-court dishes inside Beihai Park; check opening hours
Huguosi Xiaochi — old Beijing snacks, cheap and quick
Nanmen Shuanrou — old-style copper-pot mutton hotpot

2026-12-31.headline: New Year's Eve
2026-12-31.plan:
Sleep in after skiing. Afternoon: Lama Temple and the Wudaoying hutong cafés.
Night: the countdown. Last year's big ones were Shougang Park (Big Air), 798 Art District (free night event) and Jingshan for the view. Check this year's line-up in December and get there by 8 pm.
2026-12-31.food:
Hu Da on Gui Jie — famous spicy crayfish, open late; queues before the countdown
Xu Xiang Zhai — vegetarian buffet opposite the Lama Temple
Wudaoying cafés — coffee and a warm-up between sights

2027-01-01.headline: New Year's Day in the hutongs
2027-01-01.plan:
Public holiday, so expect crowds. Stay central and keep it easy.
Late morning: Nanluoguxiang and the Drum and Bell Towers.
Afternoon: skate at the Shichahai outdoor rink (use the supervised area), then Houhai.
Optional: Olympic Forest Park ice and snow carnival, if it runs again this winter.
2027-01-01.food:
Yaoji Chaogan — Beijing liver stew and baozi by the Drum Tower
Wenyu Nailao — creamy Beijing milk pudding on Nanluoguxiang
Kaorouji — Beijing barbecue since 1848, right by Shichahai

2027-01-02.headline: Universal Beijing Resort
2027-01-02.plan:
Universal Beijing Resort for the whole day. Buy tickets ahead, because the holiday weekend will be busy.
Backup plan: Summer Palace, where you can skate on Kunming Lake once it's frozen.
Last big dinner: hotpot or Peking duck round two. Pack tonight.
2027-01-02.food:
Universal CityWalk — restaurants outside the park gates, no ticket needed
Da Dong — modern Peking duck for the last big dinner; book ahead
Haidilao — hotpot with famous service, open late if the park runs long

2027-01-03.headline: Temple of Heaven, fly to Hanoi
2027-01-03.plan:
Early: Temple of Heaven (opens around 6:00, with locals doing tai chi). Grab souvenirs on the way back.
Leave for the airport around midday. It's the last day of the holiday, so allow extra time.
Flight: Beijing ~3:30 pm → Hanoi ~6:30 pm
Overnight in Hanoi, near the airport.
2027-01-03.food:
Jianbing from a street cart — Beijing's breakfast crepe
Qingfeng Baozi — steamed buns, quick and cheap before the airport

2027-01-04.headline: Hanoi → Singapore
2027-01-04.plan:
Flight: Hanoi ~8 am → Singapore ~12:30 pm
Early start for the airport. Home for lunch.
2027-01-04.food:
Bánh mì or phở near your airport hotel for breakfast
Egg coffee (cà phê trứng) — Hanoi's specialty, if a café at the airport has it
